question: Who among the following was elected as the President of Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Roger Binny.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Roger Binny** is a **former Indian cricketer** who played for the** Indian national team** from **1979 to 1987.**
 
• He was a** medium-fast bowler **and a** lower-order batsman.**
 
• Binny was elected as the** President of BCCI** in **October 2022**, succeeding **Sourav Ganguly.**
 
• This was a significant development in Indian cricket as the BCCI is the** governing body** for cricket in India and has a major influence on the sport globally.
 
• Binny has been associated with the BCCI for many years and has served as a **selector and a member **of the cricket advisory committee.
 
• He is also a **commentator and analyst **for cricket matches.
 
• Binny's appointment as BCCI President was seen as a** positive move** by many in the cricketing fraternity.
 
• He is known for his **cricketing acumen **and his ability to work collaboratively with others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Virat Kohli **is a current Indian cricketer who is widely regarded as one of the** best batsmen** in the world.

 
 
• He is the **current captain of the Indian cricket team **in all formats of the game.
 
 
 
• **Sourav Ganguly** is a former Indian cricketer who served as the** President of BCCI **from October 2019 to October 2022.
 
 
• He is credited with **revitalizing Indian cricket** during his tenure and bringing in several reforms.
 
 
 
• **Jay Shah** is a current administrator and politician who serves as the **Secretary of BCCI.**
 
 
• He is the **son of Amit Shah**, the Home Minister of India.
